title: Standardized bug repair rules
responsibility: Share coverage-first standardized bug repair rules between framework guidance and app agents.

outputs.name: bugRepairPolicy
outputs.description: A fresh array of nine plain-string bug-repair policy rules for reported bugs in generated projects and app agent runs, covering coverage diagnosis, separate failing-test and fix commits with red and green loop-record phases, causal naming/API corrections, selected-callable acceptance and read-only planning boundaries. It matters whenever a reported bug needs the shared repair procedure; each call only returns this text, runs no tests, commands or agents, and does not check or enforce the rules.
examples: For a reported bug, first diagnose why existing tests missed it. Name the responsible standardized test or scenario and its missing inputs, lifecycle, fixture or assertion; record the coverage gap before product repair.

Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared fixtures or assertions using the project's Harness scenario, state, viewport, registered-test and evidence format. Do not add a one-off bug-specific regression test.
